theme: 教材字彙・中高階 750–850 第 49 群

items.pos: adj. 令人憂心的；令人驚恐的
items.zh: 令人憂心的；令人驚恐的
items.colloc: alarming rate 驚人的速度 | alarming trend 令人擔憂的趨勢
items.distinct: alarming 令人擔憂的 | alarming signal 警報訊號
ex: The company reports an alarming drop in sales.
公司回報銷售額出現令人憂心的下滑。
There is an alarming increase in production costs.
生產成本出現了令人擔憂的漲幅。
This alarming news requires our immediate attention.
這則令人驚恐的消息需要我們立即處理。
Her witty remarks amused the entire board.
她機智的言論逗樂了整個董事會。
The software is designed to amuse the users.
這套軟體旨在娛樂使用者。
He tried to amuse the clients during dinner.
他在晚餐期間試圖娛樂客戶。
items.colloc: amuse oneself 自娛自樂 | be amused by 被…逗樂
items.distinct: amuse 娛樂 | entertain 款待；娛樂

items.colloc: strong argument 強而有力的論點 | win an argument 贏得爭論
items.distinct: argument 論點 | debate 辯論
ex: They had an argument about the budget allocation.
他們針對預算分配產生了爭論。
His argument for the new policy is convincing.
他支持這項新政策的論點很有說服力。
I do not want to start an argument today.
我不希望今天引發任何爭論。

items.pos: adj. 藝術的；有藝術天份的
items.colloc: artistic talent 藝術天份 | artistic design 藝術設計
items.distinct: artistic 藝術的 | artificial 人造的
ex: The office has a very artistic atmosphere.
這間辦公室有很濃厚的藝術氛圍。
She brings an artistic touch to the project.
她為這個專案帶來了藝術氣息。
His artistic vision impressed the creative team.
他的藝術願景讓創意團隊印象深刻。

items.colloc: defense attorney 被告律師 | consult an attorney 諮詢律師
items.distinct: attorney 律師（美） | solicitor 初級律師（英）
ex: Please consult with your attorney before signing.
簽約前請先諮詢您的律師。
The attorney reviewed all the legal documents.
該律師審閱了所有法律文件。
Our company attorney will handle the lawsuit.
我們的公司律師將會處理這場訴訟。

items.colloc: loading bay 裝貨區 | parking bay 停車格
items.distinct: bay 海灣 | harbor 港口
ex: The truck is parked in the loading bay.
卡車停在裝貨區。
We can see the bay from the office window.
我們可以從辦公室窗戶看到海灣。
All delivery items go to the east bay.
所有貨運物品都送到東側隔間。

items.colloc: boring meeting 無聊的會議 | boring task 乏味的工作
items.distinct: boring 令人無聊的 | bored 感到無聊的
ex: The long meeting was extremely boring today.
今天的長會議真是無聊至極。
I cannot stand doing such boring paperwork.
我無法忍受處理這些乏味的文書工作。
This is not a boring job if you enjoy it.
如果你喜歡的話，這並不是一份乏味的工作。

items.pos: n. 瓶子 | v. 裝瓶
items.colloc: plastic bottle 塑膠瓶 | glass bottle 玻璃瓶
items.distinct: bottle 瓶子 | jar 罐子
ex: Please recycle your empty water bottle here.
請將您的空水瓶回收在此處。
The factory will bottle the juice tomorrow.
工廠明天將會進行果汁裝瓶作業。
Each bottle contains exactly five hundred milliliters.
每一瓶剛好含有五百毫升。

items.colloc: rose bush 玫瑰灌木 | thick bush 茂密的灌木叢
items.distinct: bush 灌木 | tree 樹
ex: We planted a new bush near the entrance.
我們在入口附近種了一株新灌木。
The bush needs to be trimmed this weekend.
這株灌木這個週末需要修剪。
Staff cleared the bush around the factory.
員工清理了工廠周圍的灌木叢。

items.pos: n. 資本；首都 | adj. 大寫的；首要的
items.colloc: venture capital 創業投資 | raise capital 籌集資金
items.distinct: capital 資本 | fund 基金
ex: The startup needs more capital to expand.
這家新創公司需要更多資本來擴張。
We are looking for potential venture capital.
我們正在尋求潛在的創業投資。
The city is the capital of this country.
這座城市是該國的首都。

items.pos: v. 捕捉；俘獲 | n. 佔領；捕獲
items.colloc: capture the market 搶佔市場 | capture interest 引起興趣
items.distinct: capture 捕捉 | seize 奪取
ex: The new advertisement captured the audience's interest.
這則新廣告捕捉到了觀眾的興趣。
Our company aims to capture a larger market.
我們公司目標在於搶佔更大的市場份額。
The security camera captured the incident clearly.
監視器清楚地捕捉到了該事件。

items.colloc: carry out 執行 | carry on 繼續
items.distinct: carry 攜帶 | transport 運輸
ex: Please carry your identification card at all times.
請隨時攜帶您的識別證。
The train carries passengers to the airport.
這班火車負責運送旅客前往機場。
Our store does not carry this specific item.
我們店裡沒有販售這項特定商品。

items.colloc: product category 產品類別 | in the same category 同一類別
items.distinct: category 類別 | classification 分類
ex: Please sort the documents by category.
請依照類別將文件分類。
This product falls into a new category.
這項產品屬於一個新的範疇。
What is the category of this expense?
這筆費用的類別是什麼？

items.colloc: most certainly 當然 | certainly not 絕不
items.distinct: certainly 當然 | definitely 明確地
ex: We will certainly finish the project on time.
我們肯定會按時完成專案。
Certainly, I can help you with that task.
當然，我可以協助你處理那項工作。
The results will certainly improve next quarter.
下季的表現肯定會有所改善。

items.colloc: charity event 慈善活動 | donate to charity 捐贈給慈善機構
items.distinct: charity 慈善 | non-profit 非營利
ex: Our company supports a local charity.
我們公司支持一家當地的慈善機構。
We are hosting a charity event this Friday.
我們本週五將舉辦一場慈善活動。
All proceeds will be donated to charity.
所有收益都將捐贈給慈善機構。

items.pos: v. 切；砍 | n. 排骨；砍
items.colloc: chop up 切碎 | chop down 砍倒
items.distinct: chop 切碎 | slice 切片
ex: Please chop the vegetables for the salad.
請把製作沙拉的蔬菜切碎。
He had to chop the wood for the fire.
他必須為了生火而砍柴。
The chef started to chop the ingredients quickly.
主廚開始快速地切食材。

items.pos: v. 聲稱；索賠 | n. 聲明；索賠要求
items.colloc: insurance claim 保險理賠 | make a claim 提出索賠
items.distinct: claim 聲稱 | assert 主張
ex: He claims that the new method is faster.
他聲稱這種新方法比較快。
The customer filed an insurance claim yesterday.
該客戶昨天提交了保險理賠。
You can claim a refund for the item.
你可以針對該商品申請退款。

items.pos: n. 結束；關閉 | adj. 結束的
items.colloc: closing ceremony 閉幕典禮 | closing date 截止日期
items.distinct: closing 結束 | opening 開幕
ex: The closing date for the application is Friday.
申請的截止日期是星期五。
We have our closing meeting at four o'clock.
我們在四點鐘有結束會議。
Please sign the document before the closing.
請在結束前簽署文件。

items.colloc: confront a problem 面對問題 | confront someone 對質
items.distinct: confront 面對 | face 面對
ex: We must confront these challenges head-on.
我們必須正面面對這些挑戰。
The manager decided to confront the employee.
經理決定與該員工進行對質。
He was not prepared to confront the issues.
他還沒準備好要面對這些問題。

items.colloc: in context 在情境中 | business context 商務背景
items.distinct: context 背景 | background 背景
ex: You need to look at the phrase in context.
你需要從情境中去理解這個短語。
The context of this report is very important.
這份報告的背景非常重要。
Please provide more context for your request.
請針對你的請求提供更多背景資訊。
